messages:
chris: Starting a short thread to coordinate the v1 -> v2 migration comms and SDK snippet updates. I put a rough draft in staging: https://redwood.dev/r/4991. Need quick decisions: header name for deprecation, redirect behavior for POSTs, and a tiny set of snippets to include in the guide.

laura: For headers, prefer `X-Redwood-Deprecated: v1` so it's explicit for customers and infra. For redirects: POSTs -> 307, GETs -> 301. We'll also include a short FAQ item about clients that don't follow redirects.

vishal: Agree on 307 for POST. For SDKs, add a compat flag example and a short note that compat is temporary (90 days). I'll draft Python and Ruby snippets that show both patterns.

zoe: infra team will emit the header and keep querystring + method. We already have a staging redirect rule; smoke tests show Location + header present but one test dropped the auth header — fixing.

chris: sample TS snippet I'm proposing for docs: `import {Redwood} from '@redwood/inference'; const client = new Redwood({apiVersion:'v2'}); await client.models.create({name:'m1'}); // compat: new Redwood({compat:true}) // will translate some v1 signatures but logs a warning`. Add an inline note about model name mapping (e.g., `redwood-base-v1` -> `redwood-base-v2-compat`).

laura: I'll add a short banner copy: "Notice: v1 API deprecated. See migration guide for details and quickstart updates." Link directly to the breaking-changes anchor. Keep it concise.

vishal: created PR for snippets: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/501. Also added a curl example showing headers: `curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/models -d '{"name":"x"}'` should return 307 + `Location: /v2/models` + `X-Redwood-Deprecated: v1`.

deploy-bot: Staging deploy succeeded for docs-staging (build 1220).

zoe: infra fix merged; auth header preserved, tests green. We'll roll redirects to two regions tomorrow morning.

chris: owners: @laura banner + comms, @vishal SDK snippets + PR, @zoe infra rollout. I'll do a quick sweep of quickstarts for `/v1/` hard links and open follow-up PRs. Sync 15m tomorrow 10:30am PT to sign off. TL;DR: prefer 307 for POST, header `X-Redwood-Deprecated: v1`, add compat examples, and schedule redirects after quickstarts updated.
